description: Three-phase UPS, 200 to 500 kW: status and alarm bits, input, output and bypass measurements, battery, parallel system and configuration

sources.title: Modbus Register Map: Galaxy VL 200-500 kW

source: Schneider Electric, Modbus Register Map: Galaxy VL 200-500 kW, 990-6447 (firmware 7.23 and later)
notes: Register addresses are the absolute decimal addresses of the manual (Modicon 40001 is address 0).
Only function code 3 is supported, so every register is read-only here. Modbus RTU and Modbus TCP are supported; the serial settings are on the UPS display.
Status and alarm registers are bit words; bit 0 is the least significant bit and reserved bits are left out. Bits are atomic within one register only.
Reading a reserved register alone returns an error; a block read that starts on a valid register returns zeros for undefined ones.
The scale of registers 4867-4869, 5123-5125, 5379-5381 and 6144-6153 differs from the Galaxy VS and GPX maps.
